title: Leveraging Graph Neural Networks for Relational Data Synthesis
summary: A research codebase that models entire relational databases as graphs and trains a GNN-based generative pipeline to synthesize new databases while preserving inter-table relationships. It benchmarks this graph method against a legacy SDV HMA1 relational synthesizer and evaluates all outputs with sdmetrics' QualityReport/DiagnosticReport and HyperTransformer utilities.
